name: M2 Bradley
protection: Aluminium hull with spaced laminate and optional BRAT reactive tiles. Game rule: immune to small-calibre; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm only damage optics, tracks and exposed crew; penetrating the hull needs launchers (RPG-7 PG-7V, AT4, MAAWS, SMAW, NLAW, Javelin) or cannon. 12.7/14.5 mm can damage optics and TOW box.
visual_notes: Boxy high hull with sloped front glacis and big rear ramp
6 road wheels per side, front drive sprocket, side skirts with armour tiles
Small two-man turret offset right with folding TOW box on its left side
Commander's independent viewer (A3) on turret roof
BUSK/BRAT reactive armour bricks on sides in some configurations
